versions.changelog:
- Skill user-facing name and descriptions streamlined for clarity and accuracy.
- Skill name changed from "multi-account-mail" to "multi-account-mail-agent".
- Usability improvements: more concise instructions for first-time setup and typical actions.
- Security and operation boundaries clarified; now explicitly documents prevention of client value exposure and attachment safety.
- .gitignore file added; skill-card.md removed for file management consistency.
- Reference documents are now to be read only when needed, reducing entry complexity.

Initial release of multi-account mail agent.

- Supports management of multiple IMAP/SMTP email accounts with local configuration.
- Unified commands for searching, reading, replying, forwarding, downloading attachments, marking as read, and moving emails.
- Ensures account separation: replies and forwards use the original account by default.
- Provides workflow for mailbox inspection based on keywords and deadlines.
- Emphasizes security: sensitive values are never exposed in logs or outputs and offer multiple safe input methods.
- Includes detailed user guides for configuration, operation, and troubleshooting.
